_comment: Single source of truth for externally-sourced tool versions across the dot repo. Consumers read this instead of hard-coding a version/hash inline: nix expressions via builtins.fromJSON (egress-image.nix, goose-image.nix), scripts via `jq` (otel-edge). `track`: pinned = exact version+hash, bump deliberately; latest = fetched fresh each build, made safe by `anchor`. `pin_fallback` = known-good version to flip a latest tool to when latest breaks. Only tools whose `consumers` include a given surface are wired there yet; others are data pending wiring.

br.note: sha256 below are the GLIBC release tarballs (autopatched in the overlay). Nothing reads this entry: shared/.config/faber/base/overlay.nix, the faber box overlay, hard-codes its own copy (faber stages an overlay alone, so it cannot read this file). The values here record that pin and are kept equal to it by hand.
